# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Perform a pre-call quality assurance check to determine the address of the sample to be called and the following information:
   a. Date the sample was run
   b. Customer name
   c. Results of analytical tests
   d. Parameter that failed
   e. Test method used
3. Record the following information on your blank phone call record form:
   a. Date called
   b. Name of person called
   c. Phone number
4. Call the laboratory using their published number. Ask to speak to the person responsible for the laboratory. Do not rely on front desk staff, who are not able to talk about lab results concerning their customers.
5. Explain who you are and what the purpose of your call is. Keep a record of today's call and any additional calls made to determine the accuracy of the test results. You will need to phone the laboratory until you get all of the information you need.
